invariants.enforced_by: resident-runtime/sv_work_items.py::verify_native_hb_epoch (pure over supplied ledger bytes); validate_change/validate_issue(rec, ledger_objects) apply it when ledger bytes are supplied; without them behavior is unchanged (UNKNOWN in a NATIVE record stays DENY UNKNOWN_IN_NATIVE_RECORD)
invariants.statement: A NATIVE record's hb_epoch equals the hb_epoch carried by the organization-ledger receipt at its base ledger head (SV_CHANGE base_ref.ledger_head, SV_ISSUE observed_base.ledger_head), read from refs/stegverse/organization-ledger (HEAD.json at that commit -> receipts/<receipt_sha256 hex>.json, sealed), never from a clock.

unobserved.next_attempt: after the org writer appends at that head
unobserved.required_evidence_or_repair: bind base_ref.ledger_head to an org-ledger receipt carrying hb_epoch

invariants.enforced_by: resident-runtime/sv_work_items.py::derive_issue_from_check_receipt(receipt_bytes, ledger_ref, row, observed_base=...); rule details in data/sv-work-items/required-checks.json#check_derived_issue_rule
invariants.ledger_object_shape: the bytes at ledger_ref are a sealed org-ledger receipt (receipt_sha256 = sha256 over the other fields = the path hex) whose `evidence` is the stegverse.sv_check_receipt.v1 (P1's reading of the Labs#3255 append; the same `evidence` convention admission_learning.harvest reads)

not_ledgered.next_attempt: after the org writer appends the receipt; nothing was derived
not_ledgered.required_evidence_or_repair: the org-ledger writer (Labs#3255) appends the verifier's receipt; derive from the bytes at its ledger ref

invariants.statement: A check-derived SV_ISSUE is a deterministic derivation from the org-ledger-appended non-ALLOW check receipt: source_receipt_ref = that ledger ref (@ its receipt_sha256), failed_predicate = the receipt's failed check, surface = the check's command surface, owning_goal = the required-checks row's owning_goal. Its issue_id does not depend on who runs the derivation, so no lane owns minting: sv_work_items.derive_issue_from_check_receipt is the sanctioned derivation and fixing lanes cite the issue in resolves.

note: Invariants of the native work-items path that are not schema keywords; enforced in resident-runtime/sv_work_items.py. sv-change.v1 and sv-issue.v1 are unchanged (Lane D re-pins against 734968c0 / 62ee5307).
